name: Machine Design: Stress, Deflection & Failure
summary: Designing machine components that do not fail: load analysis, stress concentration, static and fatigue failure theories and factors of safety.

topics.name: The mechanical design process, codes, standards and design factors
Load analysis and free-body diagrams of machine components
Stress analysis review: combined stresses and stress concentration
Static failure theories for ductile and brittle materials
Fatigue design: endurance limit, Marin factors, fully reversed and fluctuating stresses
Fatigue failure criteria (modified Goodman, Gerber, ASME-elliptic)
Factor of safety, reliability-based design factors and statistical considerations
Design of simple components: levers, brackets and frames
Case study: integrated design of a complete machine
